components.name: tokens
components.description: Design tokens (color, spacing, radius, typography) exposed via SwiftUI Environment

components.name: button
components.description: 6 variants (default/destructive/outline/secondary/ghost/link) x 4 sizes (sm/default/lg/icon)

components.name: card
components.description: Card container with optional trailing action button

components.name: badge
components.description: Small status/label pill (default/secondary/destructive/outline)

components.name: input
components.description: Styled text field with focus ring and an invalid/error state

components.name: switch
components.description: Themed on/off switch, pill + sliding thumb (custom ToggleStyle) — was previously named 'toggle'

components.name: toggle
components.description: Pressable two-state button (bold/italic toolbar idiom) — default/outline x sm/default/lg. Not a switch; see 'switch' for that

components.name: label
components.description: Themed text label that dims when its context is disabled

components.name: separator
components.description: Themed horizontal or vertical divider line

components.name: avatar
components.description: Circular avatar: remote image with an initials fallback

components.name: progress
components.description: Determinate linear progress bar

components.name: skeleton
components.description: Pulsing placeholder block for loading states

components.name: checkbox
components.description: Binding<Bool>-driven checkbox with an optional label

components.name: radio-group
components.description: Single-selection list of radio options over any Hashable option type

components.name: alert
components.description: Inline default/destructive alert banner (title + optional message)

components.name: textarea
components.description: Multiline styled text field with placeholder and invalid state (iOS 16+)

components.name: tabs
components.description: Segmented tab switcher over any Hashable tag type, with content per tab

components.name: sheet
components.description: Themed wrapper over native .sheet — drag indicator, medium/large detents

components.name: confirmation-dialog
components.description: Themed wrapper over native .confirmationDialog — confirm/cancel, optional destructive role

components.name: select
components.description: Themed single-value picker (menu style) over any Hashable option type

components.name: dropdown-menu
components.description: Themed action menu (native Menu) with an icon/title/destructive item model

components.name: combobox
components.description: Searchable single-select presented in its own sheet — self-contained, no external binding

components.name: dialog
components.description: Centered modal card over a scrim, via fullScreenCover for real modal semantics and focus trapping

components.name: popover
components.description: Themed wrapper over native .popover, forced to stay a popover on iPhone via presentationCompactAdaptation

components.name: tooltip
components.description: Long-press-revealed text popover (touch analog of hover)

components.name: context-menu
components.description: Themed wrapper over native .contextMenu, reusing dropdown-menu's item model
